name: OpenAI-Proof Q&A
intro: OpenAI-Proof Q&A 是 OpenAI 的闭源内部评测，包含20个真实研究与工程瓶颈。每个问题都曾使重大项目至少延误一天，并需要 OpenAI 团队超过一天才能解决；被测模型在提供历史代码、日志、实验数据和运行工件的容器中诊断并解释根因。
build_method: 内部高影响瓶颈筛选, 历史代码日志实验数据和运行工件打包, 容器化闭源评测
modality: 文本, 代码, 日志, 指标, 运行工件
task_type: Agent诊断, 研究工程调试, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 真实内部瓶颈, 历史证据容器, 根因诊断, 评分器细节未公开
modality_en: Text, Code, Logs, Metrics, Run Artifacts
task_type_en: Agent Diagnosis, Research and Engineering Debugging, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Internal High-impact Bottleneck Curation, Historical Code Log Experiment-data and Run-artifact Packaging, Closed Container Evaluation
eval_feature_en: Real Internal Bottlenecks, Historical-evidence Container, Root-cause Diagnosis, Undisclosed Grader Details
intro_en: OpenAI-Proof Q&A is a closed internal OpenAI evaluation of 20 real research and engineering bottlenecks. Each problem caused at least a one-day delay to a major project and required an OpenAI team more than a day to solve; evaluated models diagnose and explain the root cause in a container with historical code, logs, experiment data, and run artifacts.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Section 5.1.3.4 and Table 8 of the official GPT-5.2-Codex system-card addendum. The diagrams preserve the twenty internal research and engineering bottlenecks; the requirement that each took an OpenAI team more than one day to solve and caused at least a one-day delay to a major project; examples spanning performance regressions, anomalous training metrics, and subtle implementation bugs; the evaluation container with historical code, logs, experiment data, and run artifacts; diagnosis and explanation as the target behavior; and pass@1 as the reported metric. The official source does not disclose task-authoring details, generation settings, rubric, or grader implementation, so the diagrams label these boundaries instead of inventing them. The previous GPQA-derived fallback flow was removed as unrelated.
